# Wireless Battery Tray

> Free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10/11 x64 app that shows the battery level of wireless keyboards, mice, headsets, earbuds and game controllers inside the Windows taskbar, on whichever monitor you choose. Written in Rust. Read-only: it only ever queries devices.

It supports Bluetooth headphones and earbuds, BLE keyboards and mice (including both halves of ZMK split keyboards such as the Glove80), Logitech devices on Unifying, Bolt and Lightspeed receivers (alongside or without Logi Options+), SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 headsets and the Sony DualShock 4.

## Docs

- [Home page](https://battery.faulcloud.work/index.md): Features, supported devices, install steps, known limitations and FAQ
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faulik/wireless-battery-tray/main/README.md): Full documentation, including configuration keys, updates and building from source

## Download

- [Latest release](https://github.com/Faulik/wireless-battery-tray/releases/latest): `wireless-battery-tray.exe`, or a zip that also contains the `wbt.exe` command-line tool
